title: Boolean-list value as a prefix sum
statement: For every finite Boolean list $l$, its value obtained by interpreting its entries as base-two digits equals $\sum_{j=0}^{|l|-1} b_j2^j$, where $b_j$ is the $j$th entry of $l$, interpreted as $0$ or $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Input is a finite Boolean list
